summary: The dataset now contains 23 venues transcribed from the official HKU CSO Catering directory (https://catering.hku.hk/en/eateries/). All venue names, locations, opening hours, food offering descriptions and service modes are verified against the official outlet pages. 69 menu items are representative of each outlet's stated food offerings; individual dish names and prices are approximate and not individually verified against official source pages (verified: false on menu items), except six items at BIJAS Vegetarian (halal-certified vegetarian) and 27 Kebab House (halal food), where an outlet-level certification whose stated scope is the whole outlet is recorded as item-level evidence. Dietary answers distinguish the two: dietBasis 'dish' means the item was reviewed, dietBasis 'venue' means only the outlet is certified or listed for that diet.
notCovered: Per-dish dietary review beyond those two certified outlets, individual dish-level prices, ingredient lists, allergen guarantees, holiday exceptions, temporary closures, and exact stall-level inventory are not covered. Venue-level diet listings (diets) such as 'vegetarian options' are descriptive, not certifications, and never turn into a dish-level claim. Vending machines (Vending Nook, Vending Hub), Senior Common Room (members only), and The Good Bridge (staff only) are excluded from the dataset as they are not generally accessible student dining options. Diet labels inferred from offering text (for example, "serves salads") were removed rather than surfaced as matches: an outlet answers a dietary query only when its official page states that diet. Outlets under "hints" are suggestions from menu wording only: they are not matches, carry no dietary basis, and must be confirmed with staff.
